_comment: Upgrade catalog for Radarcraft RPG (mod id checklist). One point per completed grid square. 'cost' = points per rank (default 1); a one-rank upgrade with cost > 1 is a toggle. Ranks can be removed at any time for free. 'amount' and 'amplifier' are per rank (for specials, 'amount' is the effect per rank). operation: add_value | add_multiplied_base | add_multiplied_total.

upgrades.name: Hearts
upgrades.description: +a quarter heart per point (4 points = 1 heart, 40 points = 10 hearts).

upgrades.name: Thick Skin
upgrades.description: +0.25 armor per point, worn or not (4 points = 1 armor).

upgrades.name: Sturdy
upgrades.description: +0.25 armor toughness per point: strong hits hurt less.

upgrades.name: Hardy
upgrades.description: +5% knockback resistance per point.

upgrades.name: Fireproof
upgrades.description: Burn 5.5% shorter per point. All 18 points: permanent Fire Resistance.

upgrades.name: Deep Lungs
upgrades.description: Hold your breath longer with every point. All 12 points: permanent Water Breathing.

upgrades.name: Second Wind
upgrades.description: Once every 5 minutes, a hit that would kill you leaves you at half a heart instead.

upgrades.name: Conduit Heart
upgrades.description: Permanent Conduit Power: breathe, see and mine underwater as if a conduit were near.

upgrades.name: Troll Blood
upgrades.description: Permanent Regeneration I.

upgrades.name: Iron Stomach
upgrades.description: Food never gives you Hunger or Nausea: rotten flesh, raw chicken and pufferfish are safe.

upgrades.name: Antidote
upgrades.description: Immune to Poison and Wither.

upgrades.name: Cold Blooded
upgrades.description: Powder snow and freezing never hurt you.

upgrades.name: Soul Keeper
upgrades.description: Keep 2.5% of your XP levels per point when you die; the rest still drops.

upgrades.name: Hearty Appetite
upgrades.description: Get hungry 7.5% slower per point.

upgrades.name: Fleet Foot
upgrades.description: +1.25% movement speed per point.

upgrades.name: Spring Legs
upgrades.description: Jump a little higher with every point (all 16: clear a fence).

upgrades.name: Long Stride
upgrades.description: Walk up a quarter block more per point without jumping (4 points: full blocks).

upgrades.name: Featherfall
upgrades.description: Fall 1.5 blocks further per point before taking damage.

upgrades.name: Cat Landing
upgrades.description: -12.5% fall damage per point.

upgrades.name: Swimmer
upgrades.description: Move a little faster in water per point.

upgrades.name: Sneaky
upgrades.description: Sneak a little faster per point.

upgrades.name: Surefooted
upgrades.description: Soul sand, honey and cobwebs slow you a little less per point.

upgrades.name: Blast Brace
upgrades.description: Explosions throw you around 15% less per point.

upgrades.name: Moon Walker
upgrades.description: -3% gravity per point: floatier jumps and slower falls.

upgrades.name: Dolphin Kick
upgrades.description: Permanent Dolphin's Grace: swim like a dolphin.

upgrades.name: Double Jump
upgrades.description: Press jump again in mid-air for a second jump. Recharges when you land.

upgrades.name: Brawn
upgrades.description: +0.125 melee damage per point (all 24: +3, like Sharpness V).

upgrades.name: Quick Hands
upgrades.description: +1.25% attack speed per point.

upgrades.name: Heavy Hitter
upgrades.description: Your hits knock enemies back a little further per point.

upgrades.name: Sweep
upgrades.description: Sweeping attacks deal +5% of your damage per point to everything they hit.

upgrades.name: Long Arms
upgrades.description: Hit and interact with mobs an eighth of a block further per point.

upgrades.name: Vampiric
upgrades.description: Every mob you kill heals an eighth of a heart per point.

upgrades.name: Thorny
upgrades.description: Reflect 5% of melee damage you take per point back at the attacker.

upgrades.name: Last Stand
upgrades.description: +3.75% damage per point while below 30% health.

upgrades.name: Marksman
upgrades.description: +2.5% arrow, trident and other projectile damage per point.

upgrades.name: Pickaxe Arm
upgrades.description: +2.5% block breaking speed per point.

upgrades.name: Builder's Reach
upgrades.description: Place and break blocks an eighth of a block further per point.

upgrades.name: Underwater Miner
upgrades.description: Mine a little faster while submerged per point.

upgrades.name: Lucky
upgrades.description: +0.25 Luck per point: better fishing and loot tables that care about luck.

upgrades.name: Haste
upgrades.description: Permanent Haste I, then Haste II.

upgrades.name: Magnet
upgrades.description: Dropped items drift to you from 0.75 blocks further per point.

upgrades.name: Smelter's Touch
upgrades.description: Ores you mine drop smelted results, logs drop charcoal, sand drops glass. Sneak to mine normally.

upgrades.name: Tinkerer
upgrades.description: Worn and held gear slowly repairs itself: 1 durability every 4 minutes per point.

upgrades.name: Green Thumb
upgrades.description: Crops and saplings within 6 blocks grow faster, more with every point.

upgrades.name: Night Eyes
upgrades.description: Permanent Night Vision.

upgrades.name: Giant
upgrades.description: Grow 5% per point. Bigger reach and stride, bigger target. Cannot be combined with Smol.

upgrades.name: Smol
upgrades.description: Shrink 5% per point. Fit through gaps, harder to hit, weaker stride. Cannot be combined with Giant.

upgrades.name: Shadow Step
upgrades.description: Turn invisible while sneaking and standing still.

upgrades.name: Ender Calm
upgrades.description: Endermen don't mind being looked at.

upgrades.name: Village Favorite
upgrades.description: Villagers give you hero prices: a bigger discount per rank.

upgrades.name: Studious
upgrades.description: +2.5% experience from orbs per point.
